units.source_text: 正在此时，那位藏人少将来藤侍从室中访问。

en.t: Just then, that Kurodo Lesser Captain came to call at Fuji Jijū's room.

units.source_text: 藤侍从已随两兄外出，四周人影稀少，廊上的门敞开，他就走近门边向内窥探。

en.t: Fuji Jijū had already gone out with his two elder brothers, there were few people about, and the door on the veranda stood open, so he went up to the doorway and peered inside.

units.source_text: 今天他碰到了这可喜的机会，欢喜得似同遇见佛菩萨出世一般，真乃无聊的想法。

en.t: Having come upon this delightful chance today, he rejoiced as though he had witnessed the appearance of a Buddha or bodhisattva, which was truly a foolish fancy.

units.source_text: 此时暮色苍茫，不易看得清楚。

en.t: By then the dusk was dim and hazy, making it hard to see clearly.

units.source_text: 仔细辨认，才看出穿表白里红的褂子的是大女公子。

en.t: Only after looking carefully could he make out that the one wearing a robe white on the outside and red within was the elder young lady.

units.source_text: 这确是“谢后好将纪念留”的颜色，真乃艳丽之极。

en.t: It was indeed the color of leaving a keepsake after parting, and it was truly the height of loveliness.

units.source_text: 他设想此人若归他人所有，实在太可惜了。

en.t: He imagined that if such a person were to belong to someone else, it would be far too great a pity.

units.source_text: 许多青年侍女放任不拘的姿态，映着夕阳也很美丽。

en.t: The relaxed, unrestrained figures of the many young gentlewomen were also very beautiful in the evening light.

units.source_text: 赛棋的结果，右方的二女公子胜了。

en.t: As a result of the go match, the second young lady on the right side won.

units.source_text: 右方的侍女们欢呼起来。

en.t: The gentlewomen on the right side broke into cheers.

units.source_text: 有人笑着叫喊：“还不奏高丽乐序曲？”

en.t: Someone laughed and called out, "Shouldn't you play the Koma music prelude now?"

units.source_text: 又有人兴致勃勃地说：“这株树本是二小姐的，只因靠近西室，大小姐就据为己有，为此两人争夺了多年，直到现在。”

en.t: Another, full of excitement, said, "This tree originally belonged to the second young lady, but because it stands near the west room, the elder young lady claimed it for herself, and the two of them have been fighting over it for years, right up to now."

units.source_text: 藏人少将不知道她们所谈何事，但觉非常好听，自己也想参与其间才好。

en.t: The Kurodo Lesser Captain did not know what they were talking about, but it sounded so pleasant to him that he wished he could join them.

units.source_text: 然而许多女子正在放任不拘之时，似觉未便唐突，只得独自回去。

en.t: Yet with so many women at ease and unguarded, he felt it would be improper to intrude so abruptly, and had no choice but to go back alone.

units.source_text: 此后藏人少将常来这附近暗处徘徊，希望再度逢到此种机会。

en.t: After that, the Kurodo Lesser Captain often came to loiter in the shadows nearby, hoping to encounter such an opportunity once more.
